sources.title: Rational iVario Pro L data sheet (with height adjustable substructure), RATIONAL UK, version 23

ivpl.summary: The RATIONAL iVario Pro L is a 100 litre electric tilting multi-function cooking pan that boils, pan fries and deep fries, with sensor-driven cooking assistants. It needs a three-phase 400V supply at 27 kW (21 kW with the Balanced Power option). Suits mid to large kitchens replacing a kettle, bratt pan and fryer.

highlights.text: iVarioBoost ceramic heating reaches 200 °C in under 2.5 minutes
Boiling, pan frying (30-250 °C) and deep frying (30-180 °C) in one tilting pan
Integrated pan drain: cooking or cleaning water can be emptied without tilting or a floor drain
Up to 1,200 programmes with up to 12 steps; WiFi link to ConnectedCooking
2 year RATIONAL guarantee including parts, work and journey

ivpl.notes: Datasheet weights (238 kg net) are for the version with height-adjustable substructure; Caterkwik weight 196 kg and height 608 may describe a table-top build, human to check. Caterkwik 'bain marie' heating is not in the sheet (iVarioBoost ceramic heating); plug string 'balanced power opti' is truncated. Sheet dated 4/11/2020.
